# v0.11

Released 2026-11-03.

## Highlights

- The snap moves to strict confinement with the wine user folders kept private.
- Bluetooth is documented as non-functional on Wine 11.21 at this point.
- `hardware-observe` and `process-control` plugs dropped; the `bluez` plug is enabled.

## Commits

- Reword the README introduction and the audio notes (2ac4f38)
- Document why Bluetooth does not work in wine 11.21 (a7e27e7)
- Describe the Bluetooth status in the README (8e1e768)
- Drop hardware-observe and process-control, update the status notes (b6788cb)
- Switch to strict confinement and keep the wine user folders private (5c7842d)
- Enable the bluez plug (c261b8e)
